maria (Docs): Hey folks — quick heads-up: my PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3122 is hitting a few snags in the obsv examples. The prefetch dashboard example fails in the preview and a couple of tracing hook snippets reference `trace_hook` (old param) instead of `tracehook` (new param). Can we coordinate a small sweep?

jon (Eng): saw the CI failure. repro locally: preview build errors on `console/prefetch.md` because the sample embeds a non-existent metric id.

lena (Observability): I can take the dashboard example fix (metrics id + panel JSON). Which sample path is it?

maria (Docs): thanks — it's docs/console/observability/prefetch.md and docs/snippets/tracehook-examples/* . Also noticed cost/latency breakdown snippet uses an old `cost_breakdown` field, should be `cost.annotation`. Small search/replace should do it.

kevin (SDK): I can handle the snippet API rename and run the snippet unit tests. Quick sed to rename trace param: ```bash
# run from repo root
grep -R "trace_hook" docs | cut -d: -f1 | uniq | xargs -n1 sed -i "s/trace_hook/tracehook/g"
```

jon (Eng): I pushed a tiny patch to fix the metric id in the panel JSON (PR linked in the thread). But preview still flaked on the embedded playground example — looks like the sample references `/examples/playground/embed.js` which moved. I'll send a patch to update the path.

maria (Docs): perfect. lena, can you also sanity-check the updated panel json against the dashboard schema? Quick checklist: correct `traceKey`, `cost.annotation` field, and the panel `prefetch.enabled` flag.

lena (Observability): on it. I'll run the validator: ```json
{
  "panel": "prefetch",
  "traceKey": "trace.id",
  "cost": { "annotation": true }
}
``` should be valid. If not, I'll post exact diff.

docs-bot: PR 3122 — sample-link-check FAILED: 3 broken links, 1 snippet lint error. See https://ci.redwood-inference.net/ci/3122

kevin (SDK): I'll add a tiny shim in SDK snippets to accept both `trace_hook` and `tracehook` during the rollout to avoid immediate breakage. Patch idea: ```python
# snippet shim
def normalize_trace_param(p):
    if 'trace_hook' in p:
        p['tracehook'] = p.pop('trace_hook')
    return p
```

jon (Eng): good idea for backward compat. Also suggest we add a short note in the migration guide: docs/migrations/observability-2026.md with a 1-line example and the shim suggestion.

maria (Docs): I'll add the migration note and update the PR description. Can we aim to merge the fixes today if CI green? The rollout window for the API rename is tomorrow.

lena (Observability): validator passed locally after the JSON fix. I pushed a tiny change (comments-only) to the example panel; will link shortly.

docs-bot: PR 3122 — sample-link-check OK; snippet-lint OK; preview deploy queued.

jon (Eng): preview started and looks good so far. One nit: the prefetch example shows `batch_size: 1024` which is unrealistic for our hosted defaults — suggest 64.

maria (Docs): updated to 64 in the PR. Also fixed the playground embed path.

kevin (SDK): merged shim and snippet rename tests passing locally. Will push after CI green.

docs-bot: Preview deploy succeeded: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-3122 

maria (Docs): awesome — thank you everyone. After merge I'll do a small backfill to ensure permalink redirects are in place for the moved examples. :thumbsup:

jon (Eng): thanks team :rocket:

lena (Observability): thanks!

kevin (SDK): thumbs up :thumbsup:
